name: Azure Key Vault
description: Enterprise cloud secrets management. Securely connect to Microsoft Azure Key Vault to discover, manage, and reveal secrets in your application workspaces.

fields.label: Key Vault Name or URL
fields.hint: The DNS name or full URL of your Azure Key Vault.

fields.label: Azure Tenant ID (Directory ID)
fields.hint: Microsoft Entra ID tenant containing your Key Vault.

fields.label: Application (Client) ID
fields.hint: The App Registration Client ID with Key Vault Secrets permissions.

fields.label: Client Secret (Service Principal)
fields.hint: Required for automated service principal authentication. Leave blank if using interactive login.
